full_prompt_en: A square, atmospheric painting shows a broad, empty street receding into dense blue-gray fog between rows of low houses. More than half the frame is a pale, nearly featureless sky whose cool tone merges gradually with the distant roadway. On the left, a steep-roofed house stands close to the street, its masonry softened by mist and one small window glowing vivid orange-red. A leafless tree and low wall continue along that side. The right row of houses is darker and more indistinct, with roof peaks and a few faint openings tapering toward the center. In the middle distance, a small group of dark-coated figures walks away from the viewer along the road. Their bodies are reduced to compact silhouettes, with one shorter figure at the left edge of the group. Just to their right stands a boxy cart or carriage, partly obscuring the street behind it. Thin parallel tracks run from the lower foreground toward the figures, giving direction to the wide wet or frosty ground. Small dark birds or debris punctuate the road edges near the bottom. The surface is painted with fine grain and soft, layered transitions; buildings dissolve gradually into haze instead of ending in hard outlines. The figures and cart are the most distinct elements, yet they remain nearly black against the pale mist. Light is diffuse and cold from the overcast sky, making the ground faintly luminous without strong cast shadows; the orange window is the only concentrated warmth. The overall composition places a tiny procession at the vanishing point of a wide desolate street, using restrained blue-gray space and a single warm light to create quiet tension.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、大气感强的绘画描绘一条宽阔空街，在两排低矮房屋之间退入浓密蓝灰色雾中。画面超过一半是浅色、几乎无细节的天空，其冷色调逐渐与远处道路融合。左侧，一栋陡屋顶房屋靠近街边，墙体被雾柔化，一扇小窗发出鲜明橙红色光。无叶树与低墙沿这一侧延伸。右排房屋更暗、更模糊，屋顶峰线和几个微弱开口向中央收窄。中景，一小群穿深色外套的人沿道路背向观者走去。身体被缩为紧凑剪影，群体左边还有一名较矮的人。稍靠右，一辆方盒状小车或马车停在那里，部分挡住身后街道。细平行车辙从下方前景通向人群，为宽阔、潮湿或带霜的地面提供方向。底部道路边缘有微小深色鸟影或杂点。表面以细颗粒和柔和层叠过渡绘制；建筑逐渐消失在雾中，而非以硬线终结。人物与车最为明确，但在浅雾前仍近乎黑色。光从阴云天空漫射而来，冷而均匀，使地面微微发亮，没有强烈投影；橙色窗户是唯一集中的暖意。整体构图把微小的行进人群置于宽阔荒寂街道的消失点，用克制的蓝灰空间和一处暖光形成安静张力。
style_prompt_en: The image has a softly layered painterly surface in which fine grain and mist dissolve distant edges. A narrow range of cool blue gray, slate, and pale cyan carries most of the frame, with near-black silhouettes and a very small amber accent creating the essential contrast. Large quiet areas remain nearly unmarked, while a few thin converging lines lead into compact darker forms. Illumination is broad and overcast, with surfaces gently luminous but without sharp highlights or cast shadows. Depth is produced by successive losses of contrast and detail, so shapes fade into the surrounding atmosphere rather than ending abruptly. The overall effect is spare, hushed, and melancholy, with tiny dark notes suspended in expansive cool space.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有柔和叠层的绘画表面，细颗粒与雾气使远处边缘溶解。冷蓝灰、石板色和浅青色的窄色域占据画面大部，近黑剪影与一小处琥珀色重音形成关键对比。宽阔安静区域几乎无痕，少数细汇聚线将目光带向紧凑深色形体。照明宽泛而阴沉，表面轻微发亮，却没有锐利高光或投影。纵深由对比与细节逐次消失而成，形状融入周围大气而非突然截止。整体效果稀疏、寂静且忧郁，微小深色音符悬在宽广冷色空间中。
theme_en: A small group crossing a foggy blue-gray street between low houses
theme_zh: 一小群人穿过低矮房屋之间的蓝灰色雾街
name: Jakub Schikaneder
